source.locator: zh.wikisource 神峰通考, 起大运法 阳男阴女: 甲子年正月丙寅, a male born after Lichun counts forward to Jingzhe, 折除三日为一岁, first period 丁卯. The book assumes a 30-day month and gets 10 years; in 1924 Lichun to Jingzhe is under 30 days, so the reconstructed case uses 27 days → 9 years (1924-02-08 04:12, Jingzhe 1924-03-06 04:12)
